title: Everyone: your merch sizes tonight (WS-130), and sign off your print set
detail: The printer needs 3 T-shirts and 1 hoodie per person, sizes tonight, for Friday delivery. Tell your agent: 'Write my merch sizes: T-shirt <size> <unisex|women's>, hoodie <size>'. Done so far: Vicky.

merged.why: Settled: WS-130 is done (sizes in Dinis's words, 17:10, relayed by procurement@web-summit.silvio). The sign-off half stays open: 3 of 7 sets are signed (Angelo, Dinis, Vicky), and the generic-QR set waits for Dinis to confirm (designer, 15:21).
